name: Persona toggle switches to Senior Host mode and displays host income propositions
description: When a user scrolls and switches to Senior Host persona, the platform adapts to display senior host earning propositions and verified host security badges.

planSteps.description: Scroll down past the hero section to reveal the floating persona toggle
Click the Senior Host button in the persona selector
Verify the page displays the Senior Host earning proposition and ₹10,000 safety cover guarantee
